biography:
Seasoned energy and utility leader with 15+ years of experience managing & delivering large-scale infrastructure projects across North, Central, & South America. I specialize in utility due diligence, transmission design, & infrastructure strategy for mission-critical facilities, including data centers.

With a Master's in Civil Engineering & expertise in IT infrastructure, data center development, & sustainable energy solutions, I thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments. My track record includes successfully negotiating interconnection agreements, performing risk assessments, & leading cross-functional teams to execute complex projects on time & within budget.

Key competencies: Utilities Due Diligence & Risk Assessment: Deep experience in identifying & mitigating risks associated with utility connections & infrastructure investments.

Mission-Critical Site Selection: Proven ability to evaluate & develop data center sites, incorporating utilities, networks, & feasibility analysis.

Regulatory Compliance & Renewable Energy: Extensive experience in navigating regulatory landscapes, tariff analysis, & integrating renewable energy solutions into large-scale projects.

Director of Utilities AMER
Yondr Group | Jul 2024-Present
-Lead utility engagement across North, Central, & South America to ensure seamless integration of transmission & renewable energy solutions for mission-critical data center projects. Manage utilities due diligence & infrastructure strategy, utilizing advanced tools like ArcGIS & Power BI for data analysis & decision-making. Negotiate & execute utility connection agreements, addressing tariff structures & compliance requirements. Collaborate with engineering, construction, & legal teams to streamline operations, outage planning, & delivery timelines.

Development Project Director
NextEra Energy, Inc. | Sep 2023-Jul 2024
-Directed $1.3 billion in infrastructure projects, including 100+ mile 500kV transmission lines & substations. Conducted technical feasibility studies using PLS-CADD, Primavera, & Google Earth to optimize project planning & execution. Established partnerships with renewable energy companies to meet sustainability goals & reduce operational risks.

Manager, Transmission Operations
TRC Companies, Inc. | Jan 2023-Sep 2023
-Supervised 20+ direct reports & oversaw the Southeast's transmission operations, utilizing tools like Primavera & MFAD to ensure precise project tracking. Delivered comprehensive risk assessments & outage planning for high-profile clients, ensuring alignment with technical & operational requirements.
